greet:
Hi! I will remind you about your tasks wherever you are.
Create places (/places) and tasks (/task), and I'll write when there is something to do.

Commands: /where /tasks /task /places /settings /stats /link /lang
help_text:
Commands:
/where — my current place
/tasks — tasks for the current place
/task — create a task
/edit — change or delete a task
/places — list places
/settings — all settings (reminders, language, platforms)
/stats [week|month|year|all] [csv|xlsx|chart]
/link — connect the other platform
/lang — language (ru/en)
no_places: You have no places yet. Add one by typing, e.g. Home
wizard_ask_place: Which place is this task for? Missing from the list? Type a new name.
wizard_ask_anchor_date: Start counting from which date? (e.g. 2026-11-15, “tomorrow” or tap a button)
wizard_ask_when: When do you start? “Now” means this minute. A bare time works (14.30), or a date with one (15 Nov 14.30).
wizard_ask_reminder: Remind at what time? (HH:MM, or tap a button)
btn_rem_ttl: 🕐 How often to ask about location (hours)
link_ok: Accounts linked! Reminders go to both chats.
link_bad_code: Code not found or expired. Request a new one (/link).
link_need_code: Enter the code from the other platform: /link CODE
wizard_deadline_past:
That moment has already passed — pick today or later.
{hint}
wizard_ask_time: At what time? Type it, e.g. 13.00, or tap a button.
menu_ask_more: Would you like to do anything else?
snooze_ask: How long should I snooze this reminder?
rem_ask_times: At what times to remind? HH:MM values separated by spaces — the bot will show your task list at these moments of the day. E.g.: 09:00 13:00 18:30
rem_ask_interval: Remind about tasks every how many minutes (5 or more)? E.g.: 60
rem_ask_quiet: Quiet hours: start and end, space separated (HH:MM HH:MM), e.g.: 23:00 07:00
rem_ask_ttl: Ask about the location again after how many hours (1–168), e.g.: 6
stats_heat_caption: Daily activity: brighter square = more completions; red = missed, blue = planned, orange = skipped; the outlined cell is today, days to its right are ahead
rem_when_ask:
How should I remind you about tasks?
Current: {mode}
wizard_ask_until: Finish it by when? A bare time (13.00) means the same day; Enter means 23:59; “No deadline” keeps it a plain reminder.
wizard_until_before_start:
The ready-by time must be after the start.
{hint}
rem_ask_horizon: How many days ahead should the activity chart reach? (1–90, e.g. 7)
stats_hours_caption: Hourly activity: each row is a day, each column an hour; brighter square = more finished in that hour; red = missed, blue = still open, orange = skipped
edit_delete_ask: Delete “{title}” with all of its repeats?
place_delete_ask: Delete the place “{place}”? It also removes {n} task(s), their whole history.
place_removed_tasks: {n} task(s) were removed together with the place.
